title: Oxymatrine alleviates ALD-induced cardiac hypertrophy by regulating autophagy via activation Nrf2/SIRT3 signaling pathway.
authors: Lu, Dingchun; Wu, Shun; Wang, Xueting; Zhang, Jian; Xu, Yini; Tao, Ling; Shen, Xiangchun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氧化苦参碱通过Nrf2/SIRT3通路缓解心肌肥厚，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞自噬与线粒体功能，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cardiac hypertrophy is a prevalent early pathological manifestation in various cardiovascular diseases, lacking effective interventions to impede its progression. Although oxymatrine (OMT) has shown potential benefits for cardiac function, its therapeutic efficacy and mechanism in cardiac hypertrophy remain incompletely understood. Notably, mitochondrial damage and dysregulated autophagy are pivotal pathogenic mechanisms in cardiac hypertrophy. PURPOSE: We investigate the pharmacological characteristics and mechanism of OMT in mitochondrial function and autophagy in cardiac hypertrophy. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: A murine model of cardiac hypertrophy was induced by aldosterone in combination with high-salt drinking water, while primary cardiomyocyte hypertrophy was induced by aldosterone in vitro. Cardiac hypertrophy was assessed using echocardiography and histopathological staining. Autophagosomes and mitochondrial morphology were visualized by transmission electron microscopy. Levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde (MDA), and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) were quantified using commercial kits. The binding affinity of OMT with Nrf2 was assessed through molecular docking. Furthermore, adenovirus, agonists, and inhibitors were employed to modulate Nrf2, followed by quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR), immunoblotting, co-immunoprecipitation, chromatin immunoprecipitation, immunohistochemistry, and cellular thermal shift assay. RESULTS: OMT effectively attenuated aldosterone-induced cardiac hypertrophy both in vivo and in vitro. OMT promoted the activation of Nrf2, leading to elevated SIRT3 expression and enhanced autophagolysosome fusion, thereby modulating mitophagy and improving mitochondrial function. Moreover, the cardioprotective effects of OMT were abolished upon silencing or inhibition of Nrf2. OMT binds to Nrf2, facilitating its dissociation and nuclear translocation. CONCLUSION: OMT activates Nrf2, consequently enhancing SIRT3 transcription, restoring autophagic flux, and preserving mitochondrial integrity, thereby mitigating aldosterone-induced cardiac hypertrophy. In summary, our study is the first to discover and confirm that OMT can stabilize Nrf2, promoting its activation and subsequently up-regulating SIRT3, which in turn facilitates mitochondrial autophagy. Additionally, PARKIN appears to play a key role in SIRT3-mediated regulation of mitophagy, warranting further investigation.
abstract_zh: 背景：心脏肥大（cardiac hypertrophy）是多种心血管疾病中常见的早期病理表现，目前缺乏有效干预措施以阻止其进展。尽管氧化苦参碱（oxymatrine, OMT）已显示出对心脏功能的潜在益处，但其在心脏肥大中的治疗效果和机制仍不完全清楚。值得注意的是，线粒体损伤和自噬失调是心脏肥大的关键致病机制。目的：我们研究OMT在心脏肥大中对线粒体功能和自噬的药理学特性及机制。研究设计与方法：通过醛固酮联合高盐饮水诱导小鼠心脏肥大模型，同时在体外用醛固酮诱导原代心肌细胞肥大。使用超声心动图和组织病理学染色评估心脏肥大。通过透射电子显微镜观察自噬体和线粒体形态。使用商业试剂盒定量活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）、丙二醛（malondialdehyde, MDA）和三磷酸腺苷（adenosine triphosphate, ATP）水平。通过分子对接评估OMT与Nrf2的结合亲和力。此外，使用腺病毒、激动剂和抑制剂调节Nrf2，随后进行定量实时聚合酶链反应（quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, qRT-PCR）、免疫印迹、免疫共沉淀、染色质免疫沉淀、免疫组织化学和细胞热位移分析。结果：OMT在体内和体外均有效减轻醛固酮诱导的心脏肥大。OMT促进Nrf2激活，导致SIRT3表达升高并增强自噬溶酶体融合，从而调节线粒体自噬（mitophagy）并改善线粒体功能。此外，沉默或抑制Nrf2后，OMT的心脏保护作用被消除。OMT与Nrf2结合，促进其解离和核转位。结论：OMT激活Nrf2，进而增强SIRT3转录，恢复自噬流，并维持线粒体完整性，从而减轻醛固酮诱导的心脏肥大。总之，我们的研究首次发现并证实OMT能稳定Nrf2，促进其激活并随后上调SIRT3，进而促进线粒体自噬。此外，PARKIN似乎在SIRT3介导的线粒体自噬调节中发挥关键作用，值得进一步研究。
